brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust as specified in SOP-015. Clear any obstructed ventilation in preference to deferring it to restore the cooling margin before the heat event, adhering to SOP-015 and SOP-011. Where vegetation or obstruction defects are outstanding, execute clearance work as a priority in accordance with SOP-011.
